# Handoff — T-NNN — YYYY-MM-DD

- From role / agent/session:
- To role / agent/session or unassigned:
- Timestamp (ISO with zone):
- Task / milestone / state:
- Repository revision / branch / worktree:
- Dirty/uncommitted paths and existing user changes:

## Completed and evidence

Changed files and behavior; exact commands/results; verification links; reviewer findings. Distinguish implemented, reviewed and integrated.

## Incomplete and risks

NOT RUN checks with reasons; failing checks/reproduction; hardware availability; unresolved assumptions; blocker and unblock owner. Do not hide incomplete work behind a summary.

## Decisions and contracts

ADR references, contract version and proposed tracker changes. No private chat history needed.

## Resume here

First executable action, prerequisite evidence, expected outcome and safe rollback/recovery. Receiver must verify revision and reconcile intervening changes before editing.
